avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inducer; reduces edoxaban levels and anticoagulant efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before discontinuation due to rebound thrombotic risk

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin K supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Vitamin K antagonizes Factor Xa inhibitor anticoagulant effect through vitamin K-dependent cofactor pathway
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; maintain consistent dietary vitamin K intake

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties; increases bleeding risk when combined with anticoagulants
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue supplement; monitor for bleeding signs if concurrent use unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Cranberry extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild anticoagulant and P-glycoprotein inhibitor effects; may slightly increase edoxaban levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased bleeding signs; limit high-dose consumption

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet activity; additive bleeding risk at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use in moderation; counsel on consumption amounts

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (>3g/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet effects; may potentiate anticoagulation at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor if dose exceeds 3g daily; assess for bleeding risk

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibitor; increases edoxaban bioavailability and bleeding risk

caution_foods.name: High vitamin K foods (kale, spinach, broccoli)
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive vitamin K intake may reduce anticoagulant efficacy through Factor Xa pathway interference
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent intake; avoid sudden increases in consumption

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (>2 drinks daily)
caution_foods.mechanism: Increased bleeding risk and potential hepatic metabolism effects at excessive intake
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderate consumption; monitor for bleeding if heavy use

monitoring_notes: Edoxaban has moderate interaction potential; monitor renal function as drug is renally cleared and relevant for dose adjustments. Assess baseline and periodic bleeding risk, particularly with concurrent antiplatelet agents or NSAIDs.
